groups.name: quotes-numbers
groups.description: A quote after a digit with no same-character opener on top is a measurement or a stray mark and is left alone. A single quote that would open before a number (or a currency sign or percent sign followed by a number) is left alone, together with the quote that closes it, so such a pair never converts half

groups.name: quotes-dashes
groups.description: After a dash (em dash, en dash or double hyphen) a quote opens when a word follows and closes otherwise. A single hyphen is not a dash here. After a double hyphen a closer is never left alone, because the em dash rule would put a space before it and the next pass would read it as an opener
